user.title: Connect Sporthive
user.description: Sign in with your MYLAPS (Sporthive) account and paste the link of one of your practice activities, for example {example_url}. The integration discovers your other activities from there and imports your history.

data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant to sign in again once a day. Use a password you do not use anywhere else.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Sporthive again
reauth_confirm.description: Signing in to MYLAPS failed. Check your email address and password.

error.invalid_activity: No activity ID found in this link.
error.not_found: This activity was not found or is not visible to your account.
error.invalid_auth: MYLAPS rejected the email address or password.
error.login_flow: The MYLAPS sign-in page behaved unexpectedly. Sign in once on sporthive.com (to accept any new terms) and try again. See the log for details.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MYLAPS or the Sporthive API.
error.no_chip: The activity has no transponder (chip) code.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log (search for 'sporthive') for details.
error.token_rejected: Signing in to MYLAPS worked, but the Sporthive practice API rejected the token. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This transponder is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This account belongs to a different transponder.

init.title: Sporthive activities
init.description: Tick the activities that should be ignored. They are left out of the sensors and the long-term statistics; the statistics are rebuilt after saving.
